questions.question: A and B can do a piece of work in 30 days and 15 days, respectively, A and B start the work together. In how many days will the entire work be completed?
questions.solution:
Given that 

A takes 30 days to complete the work.

one day work of A = 1/30

B takes 15 days to complete the work.

one day work of B = 1/15

work done by ( A + B ) in one day = (1/30) + (1/15)

= (1 + 2) / 30

= 3/30

= 1/10

work done by ( A + B ) in one day = 1/10

Total work (1 unit ) will be completed by ( A + B) = 10 days

Hence, **10 **will be the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15ce302f1d73a32f8aca2071d921c283bc9348ec788e7ae24f8d4bd19db94a57.png] 

Work / efficiency method

(A + B) takes = 30/ (1+2)

(A + B) takes = 30/3

(A + B) takes= 10 days

questions.question: If '$' stands for 'addition', '@' stands for 'subtraction', '&' stands for 'multiplication' and '#' stands for 'division', then what is the value of the following expression? 16 @ 26 $ 8 & 14 # 7
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Decoding the information, 

 
 

 
 
Symbol

 
 
 
$

 
 
 
@

 
 
 
 &

 
 
 
#

 
 
 

 
 
Meaning

 
 
 
 +

 
 
 
-

 
 
 
× 

 
 
 
÷ 

 
 
 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e9f11ce69db0914232086705065ed63ee23501928b90fa8b440c14d1b555483.png] 

16 @ 26 $ 8 & 14 # 7

Putting the value of symbol

= 16 - 26 + 8 × 14 ÷ 7

After applying BODMAS

= 16 - 26 + 8 × 2

= 16 - 26 + 16

= 32 - 26

= 6

Hence,** Option 1** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Four positions of a DICE are shown. Find out which number occurs on the face opposite to the face having the number '4'?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c93651f048a15f0ad8d2ecfc9e5ed8f9597df64418d6b6820c443cb5f6d5e5ec.png]
questions.solution:
**Concept:**

when any two faces are common in any two cubes then the remaining faces of that cube become opposite to each other.

From figure (i) and (ii) The face 2 and 3 are common, therefore the remaining 4 and 6 become opposite to each other.

The opposite of 4 is 6.

Hence, **6 **is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number and the sixth number is related to the fifth number.

168 : 8 :: 84 : ? :: 105 : 5
questions.solution:
The second number is related to the first number and the sixth number related to the fifth number. 168 : 8 :: 84 : ? :: 105 : 5

Second number is multiplied by 21 we get first number. Sixth number is multiplied by 21 we get fifth number. 

Similarly, fourth number is multiplied by 21 we get third number 

X × 21 = 84

X = 84 over 21

X = 4

Hence, **option 3** is the correct answer.
